title: Gives the default remaining digit when a value is missing
goal: Use null merging to distinguish missing data from valid zeros.
summary: data source may not return the remaining digits, or it may explicitly return 0. In the former case, use the planned remainder, and in the latter case, it must be displayed truthfully.
tasks: Completes availableSeats(actual, planned), returning planned only if actual is null or undefined.

example.note: ?? is only used when the left side is null or undefined.

hint: || will also regard 0 as a situation that requires backup. You can use ?? for this question.
